Question B-006-003-009.

Why the correct answer is right: A solid outer conductor provides continuous shielding with no braid openings. That continuous metal barrier offers the best shielding of the listed coaxial outer-conductor types.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Aluminum foil": Foil can give good coverage, but it is thin and not the strongest or best overall shield compared with a solid outer conductor.
- sourceIndex 2: "Single braided shield": A single braid has small openings between strands, so some leakage is possible.
- sourceIndex 3: "Double braided shield": Double braid improves on single braid, but it still is not as continuous as a solid shield.
